svg.title: Proposition 40: Continuous quantum confidence regions and regularity obstructions
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Proved finite-preparation no-go theorem plus a continuous-region regularity certificate. P40 addresses the next limitation exposed by P39. A continuous tomography confidence region generally contains quantum state assignments that are distinct but arbitrarily close. If the bridge from quantum state to target law is completely unrestricted, closeness alone.. Visible guideposts include: Without collisions or regularity, injective finite descriptors defeat unrestricted non-factorization tests.; NO-GO LAYER; Injective finite descriptor; ρx ≠ ρx′ for x ≠ x′; any target y factors as y=g∘Q; Unrestricted bridges can memorize the finite image.. How to read it: follow the diagram in the direction of its arrows and use each box, panel, inequality, or highlighted region only with the meaning printed beside it. Main takeaway: this is the visual companion to Proposition 40; the proposition document supplies the assumptions, proof, and exact scope of every implication. Scientific status: Proposition 40 theorem/certificate visual. It is not independent empirical evidence and does not, by itself, identify a physical or latent variable with consciousness.
